Thanks for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward. Our legal team has a couple of asks before we can finish procurement: a fully executed DPA (we attached our redline), confirmation of SOC 2 Type II report, completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ, and confirmation on SCCs for EU data flows (we have a small number of EU customers in scope). Hi Emily — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Quick plan from our side: 

- We will provide the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and the completed SIG/CAIQ by EOD today.
- I reviewed your DPA redline briefly — Karthik (Legal) will do a full pass on the redlines and flag any high-risk asks.

- HIPAA: we support HIPAA-covered workflows; I will include our HIPAA attestation and the architecture note on PHI handling.

I am looping in Karhtik for legal redline commentary and Vanessa for AE exec alignment — we want to keep momentum here.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: DPA + SOC2 + SCCs for BlueWave onboarding

Neha — thanks for the loop. Quick legal read: I reviewed BLUEWAVE-DPA-Redlines.docx and flagged the principal concerns. Attached is a comment pass (DPA_redline_karthik_comments.docx). High-level:

1) Data retention: BlueWave requests 7 years retention for certain records — that's atypical for our standard offering. We can propose a compromise (12 months primary retention + archival hashed storage for up to 7 years) and require documented lawful basis for long-term retention.
2) Subprocessor carveouts: BlueWave is asking for explicit subprocessor liability carveouts. We should avoid broad liability language; offer a predefined subprocessor list and SLA for notification.
3) HIPAA scope: confirm whether BlueWave will be a Business Associate; if so we need the BA terms and a more detailed scoping call.

If we accept the retention compromise it will likely require a one-off Exec exception (Legal + Security sign-off). I recommend routing the proposed compromise to ops/security for confirmation of archival pseudonymization.

Attaching: DPA_redline_karthik_comments.docx

- Karthik
General Counsel (Contracts) | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
